name: abtest-solution
description: Internal A/B testing solution exposed as a federated module.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,remote,ui -c green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @abtest-solution/api" "npm run dev -w @abtest-solution/remote" "npm run dev -w @abtest-solution/ui"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @abtest-solution/core && npm run build -w @abtest-solution/storage-fs && npm run build -w @abtest-solution/api && npm run build -w @abtest-solution/remote && npm run build -w @abtest-solution/ui
